## AprilRemake

An original remake of Luki120's April, with a looping video wallpaper mode added on top of April's existing image, gradient, blur and cell-alpha customization for the Settings app.

- **Video Wallpaper** (new): loop a video from your Photo Library as the Settings background, with an independent Mute toggle
- Custom dark mode / light mode image
- Custom scheduled images: morning, afternoon, sunset & midnight
- Custom blurs: epic, dark, light, adaptive & thin material
- Custom table cell alpha
- Gradients with custom directions & optional animation
Built on top of [April](https://github.com/Luki120/April) by Luki120 (MPL-2.0). The video wallpaper mode is an original addition not present in upstream April.

## 1.0
- Initial release: original remake of April
- New: looping video wallpaper mode for Settings, with Mute toggle
- All of April's original features preserved (images, scheduled images, blur, cell alpha, gradients)
